Subject: Alert on theft of multiple drug products of M/s Novo Nordisk during
transit-reg
M/s Novo Nordisk has informed about a theft of its products, as mentioned below, during
transit from its Bhiwandi Hub to milk route (Nagpur, Raipur, Cuttack, and Kolkata). The
products under consideration are rDNA origin injectables which are required to be stored
at 2-8°C. The quality of the products may be compromised if the products are not
handled in proper storage conditions since the formulations are supposed to be
maintained at 2°C to 8°C failing which, would impact the quality of the product and in turn
impact the safety of the patients. The matter is currently under investigation by the
Police.

Based on the above, the following advisory is provided:
e Doctors and Healthcare professionals
o Carefully prescribe and educate the patients for reporting of
any ADRs.
e Patients and consumers
o To be careful and procure the above products from authorized
sources only and with proper invoice.
e Regulatory authorities (All state/UT Drugs Controllers and
Zonal/Sub-Zonal offices of CDSCO)

o Instruct your officers to keep a strict vigil on the movement of
the said products in the market and initiate necessary action
under the provisions of Drugs & Cosmetics Act, 1940 and

: Rules made thereunder
